01地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月21日

霍尔木兹油轮遭投射物击中起火，过去一周全球袭击增至 15 起

Fire reported on tanker after projectile strike off Oman, UKMTO says

An outbound tanker was hit by an unknown projectile on its port bow about eight nautical miles north of Khasab at around 1500 UTC on 20 November, sparking a fire with no casualties or environmental impact reported, UKMTO Warning 214-26 said; the vessel was not identified. Iran's Revolutionary Guard said the tanker struck a mine, which has not been reconciled with UKMTO's account or independently verified. Orbital Risk Intelligence counted 15 attacks or piracy-related incidents worldwide in the past seven days, up 50%, including seven in the Persian Gulf, Hormuz and Gulf of Oman involving six vessels, with two seafarers missing and 13 injured, while Hormuz transits remain about 65% below pre-conflict levels and JMIC rates the threat severe. This is a new 20 November incident.

UKMTO 警告 214-26 称，一艘驶出霍尔木兹海峡的油轮 11 月 20 日约 1500 UTC（新加坡 23:00）在阿曼 Khasab 以北 8 海里遭不明投射物击中左舷船首并起火，公司安全官报告无伤亡、无环境影响，当局调查中，船名未披露。伊朗革命卫队称该船系触雷起火，与 UKMTO 说法不一致、未独立证实。gCaptain 引 Orbital Risk Intelligence 称过去 7 天全球 15 起袭击/海盗相关事件（环比增 50%），波斯湾/霍尔木兹/阿曼湾 7 起涉 6 船、2 名海员失踪 13 人受伤，霍尔木兹过境仍较冲突前低约 65%，JMIC 维持 SEVERE 评级。本条为 11-20 新发生的袭击，与昨日已刊个案不同。

沙特联军打击荷台达港，胡塞下令船舶撤离沙特红海港口

Houthis Order Ships to Leave Saudi Red Sea Ports After Hodeidah Airstrikes

The Saudi-led coalition struck Yemen's Red Sea port of Hodeidah on Friday, saying it destroyed operational capabilities used for smuggling weapons and ballistic missiles, while Yemen's information minister said the port remains fully operational. Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree warned staff and people near Saudi Red Sea ports to evacuate immediately, urged shipping companies to remove their vessels at once and told airlines to avoid Saudi airspace except near Mecca and Medina, saying new airstrikes would come within hours and naming the Shuqaiq power plant. This is a new Red Sea escalation, distinct from yesterday's Hormuz reports.

沙特领导的联军周五打击也门红海荷台达港，称摧毁用于走私武器与弹道导弹的作战能力；也门信息部长称港口仍完全运营、货物流通继续。胡塞军事发言人 Yahya Saree 警告沙特红海港口员工及周边人员立即撤离，敦促航运公司立即撤走船舶，并警告航空公司避开沙特空域（麦加/麦地那附近除外），称数小时内将有新空袭并点名 Shuqaiq 电站。本条为红海航线新升级，与昨日霍尔木兹条目不同海域。

The Houthis said they carried out accurate and direct strikes on the Al-Shuqaiq power plant and Jazan port causing extensive damage, while the coalition said two ballistic missiles were intercepted over the Jazan region with debris falling on Al-Shuqaiq; neither account has been independently verified. 04地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月20日

美财政部敦促新加坡与马来西亚加强伊朗制裁合规

US Treasury Presses Singapore and Malaysia on Iran Sanctions Compliance

US Treasury officials met Singaporean and Malaysian authorities this week to warn of the risks of non-compliance with Iran sanctions, urging both countries and local law firms and banks to watch for Iranian front companies and to scrutinise high-risk areas including maritime shipping, aviation services and procurement networks. The waters of Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia have long hosted ship-to-ship transfers of Iranian oil to obscure its origin; Malaysia seized two tankers and their cargoes in February, and in July the Treasury sanctioned dozens of individuals, vessels and companies in Singapore and elsewhere linked to Iranian oil magnate Mohammad Hossein Shamkhani. Singapore said it is firmly committed to its obligations; Malaysia did not respond to a request for comment.

美财政部官员本周会见新加坡与马来西亚政府当局（含监管与国家安全机构），警告不遵守对伊制裁的风险，敦促两国及当地律所、银行警惕伊朗前台公司，重点审查海运、航空服务、采购网络等高风险领域。背景是马新印尼水域长期有伊朗石油船对船转运以掩盖来源，马来西亚今年 2 月扣押两艘油轮及货物，7 月美财政部制裁与伊朗石油大亨 Mohammad Hossein Shamkhani 关联的新加坡等地数十个个人、船舶与公司。新加坡政府称坚定履行义务、防止滥用公司载体；马来西亚政府未回应置评请求。

05地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月20日

法国大西洋海岸散货船 MIRO G 搁浅，19 名船员直升机撤离

Crew Airlifted After Bulk Carrier Grounds on French Coast

The Malta-flagged, 169-metre bulk carrier MIRO G (built 2011, about 28,200 dwt, in ballast) grounded near Lit-et-Mixe in France's Landes department shortly after midnight on 20 November after reporting heavy swell and strong crosswinds, dragging anchor in 48-knot gusts after an emergency anchoring. A French Air and Space Force helicopter airlifted 19 of 22 crew, with the captain and two others remaining aboard; a naval assessment team boarded, the emergency tug Abeille Bretagne sailed from Brest and no pollution was initially found, though more than 100 tonnes of diesel aboard pose a pollution risk and defuelling before refloating is being considered in 5–6 metre seas. The vessel had been bound for Rouen to load about 30,000 tonnes of wheat for Libya.

马耳他旗 169 米散货船 MIRO G（2011 年造，约 28,200 载重吨，空载）11 月 20 日午夜后不久在法国西南 Landes 省 Lit-et-Mixe 附近搁浅，此前报告大涌浪与强横风、操纵困难，紧急锚泊后 48 节阵风致走锚漂向岸边。法国空天军直升机撤离 22 名船员中 19 人，船长及 2 人留船；法海军评估队已登船，紧急拖轮 Abeille Bretagne 自 Brest 出发，初步未发现污染，但船上逾 100 吨柴油构成污染风险，正考虑先抽油减重再拖带，浪高 5–6 米。该船原赴 Rouen 装约 30,000 吨小麦运往利比亚。

06地缘政治与海事安全 · 2026年11月20日

赴美油轮遭破坏性网络攻击，FBI 与海岸警卫队登船调查

FBI investigates tanker cyberattack designed to destroy data

New details have emerged of a destructive cyberattack on a US-bound tanker in which hackers wiped onboard computers and sent mocking political messages, after which the FBI and US Coast Guard boarded the vessel. An IMCA safety alert of 5 November said the unnamed ship, sailing from Egypt to Galveston, Texas, lost operating systems and stored data on multiple computers connected to its server, with external email and ship-management applications also disrupted, and the attackers then emailed claims to control the tanker. IMCA said the damage was consistent with a wiper attack aimed at destroying data rather than extorting ransom, with no anomalies found in operational technology systems and damage confined to the business IT network; the operator isolated affected equipment and restored from backups, while investigators found multiple cybersecurity shortcomings and the initial entry path remains unknown. US authorities said in September that investigators had boarded two Texas-bound tankers in August over suspected cyberattacks.

Splash 称一艘赴美油轮遭破坏性网络攻击的新细节浮现：黑客擦除船上电脑并发送嘲讽性政治信息，其后 FBI 与美国海岸警卫队登船。据 IMCA 11 月 5 日安全警报，这艘未具名船舶从埃及驶往得克萨斯州加尔维斯顿，连接船上服务器的多台电脑操作系统与存储数据丢失，外部邮件与船舶管理应用亦受扰，攻击者随后发送声称已控制油轮的邮件。IMCA 称损害与以破坏数据而非索赎为目的的 wiper 攻击一致，检查未发现船舶运营技术系统异常，损害限于业务 IT 网络；运营方隔离受损设备并以备份恢复，调查发现多项网络安全缺陷，初始入侵路径仍不明。美方 9 月披露调查人员曾在 8 月登上两艘赴得州油轮（疑似网络攻击）。

Oil Posts Third Weekly Loss Amid Surplus

Brent for January settled at $92.57 a barrel on 20 November, up 0.6%, while WTI for January settled at $83.41, up 1.2%, and WTI for December settled at $83.98, up 0.9%, on its expiry day; Brent fell 3.4% on the week (the Business Times said nearly 4%, a rounding difference noted here), its third weekly loss, and is down about 20% this month. 08能源、油气与LNG · 2026年11月20日

美承包商联合体赢得澳大利亚 Ichthys LNG 下一阶段水下合同

US contractors win subsea package on Australian LNG megaproject

A consortium of McDermott and Baker Hughes has won a subsea EPCI contract under its existing framework with Inpex for the next development phase of the Ichthys LNG project offshore Western Australia, to commission new subsea infrastructure and tie it into the existing offshore production system, with Baker Hughes supplying subsea trees, controls and wellheads and McDermott handling engineering, fabrication and installation, including fabrication at Batam in Indonesia. The award follows Inpex's approval earlier this month of Ichthys Phase 2c Part 1, drilling five new production wells; Ichthys lies in the Browse Basin about 220 km off Australia's northwest coast with capacity of up to 9.3 million tonnes of LNG a year. No contract value was disclosed.

McDermott 与 Baker Hughes 组成的联合体在与 Inpex 的现有水下开发框架协议下，获得西澳 Ichthys LNG 项目下一开发阶段的水下 EPCI 合同，内容为调试新的水下基础设施并接入现有海上生产系统；Baker Hughes 供应水下采油树、控制系统与井口，McDermott 负责工程、制造与安装，制造在印尼巴淡岛船厂。合同跟随 Inpex 本月早些时候批准 Ichthys Phase 2c Part 1（钻 5 口新增生产井）；Ichthys 位于布劳斯盆地、距澳西北海岸约 220 公里，年产能最高 930 万吨 LNG。合同金额未披露。

09能源、油气与LNG · 2026年11月20日

埃克森美孚向 TechnipFMC 授圭亚那 Longtail 水下设备合同

ExxonMobil hands TechnipFMC fresh Guyana subsea work

TechnipFMC has won two subsea equipment contracts from ExxonMobil for the $12.5 billion Longtail gas-condensate development in Guyana's Stabroek block: the first, rated large at $500 million to $1 billion, covers project management, engineering and manufacturing of the subsea production system including Subsea 2.0 trees, manifolds and controls, and the second, rated significant at $75 million to $250 million, covers flexible production risers; both were booked in prior quarters. Longtail, approved by the government with a final investment decision earlier this month, is the eighth approved Stabroek development, with about 45 subsea wells tied back to a new FPSO handling 1.2 billion cubic feet of gas and up to 250,000 barrels of condensate a day, targeting first production in 2030; ExxonMobil operates with 45%, alongside Hess at 30% and CNOOC at 25%.

NYK 将发电机频率控制技术推向商用，试验节油约 10%

NYK takes generator frequency tech commercial

NYK and four Japanese technology partners have begun commercial sales of the Hz Controller marine generator control system, which achieved about 10% fuel savings in onboard trials and is now offered to owners outside the NYK fleet for newbuild installation and retrofit, with testing confirming energy-saving performance and operational safety. The partners are NYK, its research arm MTI, Oshima Shipbuilding, Terasaki Electric and Daihatsu Infinearth. The system lowers generator frequency when conditions allow, cutting power draw from frequency-dependent equipment such as pumps and motors to reduce auxiliary generator load and fuel use, switching between normal and low energy-saving frequencies within class limits. Demonstration on the NYK-operated 60,343 dwt bulker White Princess from April 2023 to April 2024, then called Hz Navi at about 57Hz against the usual 60Hz, cut generator fuel use by about 10% with no operational anomalies, with savings varying by ship type, conditions and equipment use; Terasaki Electric will design and supply the commercial system and Daihatsu Infinearth will widen compatible generator models.

NYK 与四家日本技术伙伴已开始商业销售船用发电机控制系统 Hz Controller，该系统在船上试验中实现约 10% 节油；现向 NYK 船队外船东开放新造安装与改装，测试已确认其节能性能与运行安全。项目方为 NYK、其研究机构 MTI、大岛造船、寺崎电气与 Daihatsu Infinearth。系统在工况允许时降低发电机频率，减少泵、电机等频率相关设备的功耗，从而降低辅发电机负荷与油耗，在船级规范限值内于正常频率与低节能频率间切换。示范在 NYK 运营的 60,343 载重吨散货船 White Princess 上于 2023 年 4 月至 2024 年 4 月进行（当时称 Hz Navi，约 57Hz 对常规 60Hz），发电机油耗降约 10% 且无运行异常（节油随船型、工况与设备使用而异）；寺崎电气负责商用系统设计供应，Daihatsu Infinearth 扩大兼容发电机机型。

IMO：海事气候融资六年仅 105 亿美元

IMO Finds Just $10.5 Billion in Maritime Climate Finance

Direct maritime climate finance tracked by the IMO and Climate Policy Initiative under GHG-SMART totalled just $10.5 billion from 2018 to 2023, 0.14% of global climate finance, reaching $4.7 billion in 2023 at 49% compound annual growth but driven by a few large projects, while decarbonising international shipping and shore infrastructure will need $1.2 trillion to $1.6 trillion by 2050. Over the six years port infrastructure took 39%, alternative fuel production and distribution 24%, maritime operational technology 11% and shipbuilding and recycling just 0.02%; in 2023 alternative fuels at $2.5 billion plus ports at $1.4 billion made up about 83%, with commercial debt at 61% and grants at 12%. Small island developing states and least developed countries received 68% of adaptation finance but only 1.5% of mitigation finance, and the IMO acknowledges domestic public spending and private retrofit, efficiency and shipbuilding investment are not fully captured, so $10.5 billion is not total decarbonisation investment.

IMO 与 Climate Policy Initiative 在 GHG-SMART 下追踪 2018–2023 年直接海事气候融资仅 105 亿美元，占全球气候融资 0.14%；2023 年达 47 亿美元（年复合增长 49%，但由少数大项目驱动）；到 2050 年国际航运脱碳及岸基基础设施需 1.2–1.6 万亿美元。结构上六年港口基础设施占 39%、替代燃料生产分销 24%、海事运营技术 11%、造船回收仅 0.02%；2023 年替代燃料 25 亿美元加港口 14 亿美元合计约 83%；商业债务占 61%、赠款 12%。小岛屿发展中国家/最不发达国家获 68% 适应融资但仅 1.5% 减缓融资；IMO 承认国内公共支出与私营改造、能效、造船投资未完整捕获，105 亿非全部脱碳投资。

重新思考海事战争险

Rethinking marine war risk insurance

The column recounts a tanker whose broadcast position jumped from Fujairah to Iran's Kharg Island last year, triggering a US sanctions review and a 45-day freeze on bank transactions, though the ship never went to Iran; about 400 vessels a month faced satellite navigation interference in 2025, rising to nearly 1,100 on the first day of the 2026 Iran conflict. War risk insurance depends on vessel position, the author notes, yet the Joint War Committee has redrawn listed areas three times this year just as jamming makes positions harder to verify, and false positions can imply entry into sanctioned ports or war-risk zones, prompting compliance probes, bank delays and insurance disputes. Four practices are proposed: building vessel behaviour histories before underwriting, independently verifying positions in high-risk waters with commercial satellite imagery and RF detection, setting clear investigation triggers, and sharing responsibility for position integrity between owners and insurers, with one war-risk mutual earlier this year discounting premiums for members fitting assured positioning receivers. This is an opinion column; figures are as stated by the author. Published 2026-11-20T02:00:21Z, i.e. 10:00 Singapore time.

专栏称去年一艘油轮因广播位置从富查伊拉跳至伊朗哈尔克岛触发美国制裁审查、银行交易被冻 45 天，而该船从未去过伊朗；2025 年每月约 400 艘船遭遇卫星导航干扰，2026 年伊朗冲突首日该数字近 1,100 艘。作者指出战争险依赖船舶位置，而联合战争委员会今年已三次重划列名区域，恰在导航干扰使位置更难核实之时；虚假位置可暗示进入制裁港口或战争险区域，引发合规调查、银行延误与保险争议。作者提出四项做法：承保前建立船舶行为历史、在高风险水域以商业卫星影像与射频探测独立核实船位、设定明确调查触发条件、由船东与保险人共担位置完整性责任，并称今年早些时候一战争险互保协会已对安装 assured positioning 接收器的会员给保费折扣。属观点文章，数字为作者陈述口径。发布时间 2026-11-20T02:00:21Z，折合新加坡 11-20 10:00。

Crew travel dilemma: Book early and risk cancellation or pay more

Nearly half of seafarer flights booked at least a week ahead are eventually cancelled, according to new research by Rotterdam maritime travel platform C Teleport: bookings made more than seven days out had a 48.5% cancellation rate, against 18.1% for those made within 24 hours of departure. The study covers 12 months of crew travel bookings on its platform, with flights scheduled from October 2025 to September 2026: 63% of seafarer flights were booked within seven days of departure, nearly a quarter in the final 48 hours, and about 30% outside normal office hours. Late booking costs more, with the median Manila to Singapore fare bought less than seven days ahead 56% higher than fares bought 30 to 90 days ahead. The study covers only C Teleport bookings, not the whole maritime travel market, and does not disclose total ticket numbers, a limitation noted in the report.

鹿特丹海事差旅平台 C Teleport 的新研究称，提前至少一周预订的海员机票近半最终取消：提前 7 天以上预订的取消率 48.5%，出发前 24 小时内预订的为 18.1%。研究基于其平台 12 个月海员差旅预订（航班计划于 2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 9 月）：63% 的海员航班在出发前 7 天内预订、近四分之一在最后 48 小时，约 30% 预订在正常办公时间之外。临近出发预订价格更高：马尼拉—新加坡航线提前不足 7 天购买的中位票价较提前 30–90 天高 56%。研究仅覆盖 C Teleport 平台预订而非整个海事差旅市场，且未披露分析票数总量，原文已注明此限制。

谁来判定船员是否胜任？

Who decides whether crew are competent?

Citing the 2020 LPG carrier Moritz Schulte accident, where the MAIB's 2023 investigation found a competence system in place but evidence for only two of 65 promotion tasks and unrealistic positive assessments directly enabling premature promotion, and the 2015 El Faro sinking, where the NTSB found training and crew competence assessment split between departments without shared records, the article argues that STCW certificates, ISM requirements and computer-course completions do not prove task competence; what matters is performance standards, the relevance, sufficiency and consistency of assessment evidence and separation of assessor and verifier roles, citing IMCA C001 and Shell's structured assessment practice. It cites October 2026 Thetius research for OneOcean in which 52% of maritime professionals said qualified crew often struggle in practice and 54% saw large competence differences between ships in the same company, noted as perception data rather than competence measurement. This is an opinion feature with no new event.

文章以 2020 年 LPG 船 Moritz Schulte 事故（MAIB 2023 年调查称公司有能力管理制度、65 项晋升任务仅 2 项有证据完成，不切实际的正面评估直接导致越级晋升）与 2015 年 El Faro 沉没（NTSB 称培训与船员能力评估分属两部门、记录未互通）为例，论证 STCW 证书、ISM 要求与电脑课程完成记录均不能证明具体任务能力，关键在绩效标准、评估证据的相关性/充分性/一致性及评估者与验证者分工（引 IMCA C001 与 Shell 的结构化评估做法）。文引 2026 年 10 月 Thetius 为 OneOcean 所做研究：52% 受访海事专业人士称合格船员常在实际操作中吃力、54% 称同一公司不同船间能力差异大，并注明此为感知数据而非能力测量。属观点长文，无新事件。

通信中断时业务不应中断

When communication stops, business shouldn't

Using the 12–13 November global Microsoft 365 outage, which affected Exchange Online and Outlook for nearly 24 hours and led Maersk to warn customers of possible email and notification delays, the author argues maritime businesses are dangerously dependent on single communications platforms: vessels, shore teams and third parties span time zones with intermittent connectivity, and an outage can disrupt port arrival coordination, crew changes, vessel planning and technical troubleshooting. Business continuity should be treated as an operational responsibility, not only an IT matter, the article says, identifying critical dependencies and single points of failure, building fallback communications that do not rely on the same infrastructure and testing them regularly so staff can maintain essential operations when usual systems fail. This is an opinion article with no new event data. Published 2026-11-20T01:00:00Z, i.e. 09:00 Singapore time.

作者以 11 月 12–13 日微软 365 全球故障（近 24 小时影响 Exchange Online、Outlook 等，Maersk 曾警告客户邮件与通知可能延迟）为例，论证海事企业对单一通信平台的依赖风险：船舶、岸基团队与第三方跨时区且连接间歇，通信中断可影响港口到港协调、船员换班、船舶计划与技术问题解决。文章主张业务连续性应视为运营责任而非仅 IT 事项，须识别关键依赖与单点故障、建立不依赖同一基础设施的替代通信安排并定期测试，使员工在常用系统不可用时仍能维持基本运营。文中无新事件数据，属观点文章。发布时间 2026-11-20T01:00:00Z，折合新加坡 11-20 09:00。
